minutes.headline: Planning Board sent four warrant articles to the Nov 16 town meeting and asked capital planning for master plan money.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board continued the Reservoir Road traffic review, both 360 Flat Hill Road hearings and 101 Pleasant Street to October 25. It accepted the withdrawal of the Cross Street/Mulpus Road application without prejudice. It voted to submit four zoning warrant articles and to request master plan funding from capital planning.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to submit four warrant articles for the November 16, 2021 town meeting.
The board voted to submit a capital planning request for a master plan update, with a warrant article as the backup if it is not funded.
The board continued the Reservoir Road, 360 Flat Hill Road (scenic road and stormwater) and 101 Pleasant Street hearings to October 25 at 6:35 p.m.
The board accepted withdrawal without prejudice of the application for 97 and 125 Cross Street and 430 and 440 Mulpus Road.
The board agreed to write Board of Health soil and water testing recommendations into the 360 Flat Hill Road stormwater decision as conditions.

why_it_matters: The four warrant articles are zoning changes that voters at the November 16 town meeting will be asked to approve or reject.
The master plan update would be paid for through capital planning or a warrant article, so residents may be asked to vote on that spending.
watch_next: October 25 at 6:35 p.m.: the next Planning Board meeting, where the continued Reservoir Road, 360 Flat Hill Road and 101 Pleasant Street hearings resume.
November 16, 2021: the town meeting that takes up the four warrant articles.
